title: REtrospective Study of TESTIcular CAncer Patients at the University Magdeburg
brief_summary: Retrospective analysis of treatment outcome and side effects of testicular cancer patients that had been diagnosed at the University Magdeburg from 1960 until 2012.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* testicular cancer histopathologically diagnosed at the University Magdeburg Germany

Exclusion Criteria:

* none.
study_population: Testicular cancer histopathologically diagnosed at the University Magdeburg 1960-2012
